title: Democratic Senators Demand Probe Into World Liberty Financial’s Alleged Ties To North Korea: CNBC
summary: World Liberty Financial has come under scrutiny as Elizabeth Warren and Jack Reed have urged U.S. officials to probe claims that the Trump-linked crypto firm has sold tokens to buyers tied to money-laundering platforms and North Korean and Russian actors.The postDemocratic Senators Demand Probe Into World Liberty Financial’s Alleged Ties To North Korea: CNBCappeared first onCryptonews.

title: He worked four blue-collar jobs in his teens to stay afloat. Today, his fintech startup is worth $8 billion
summary: Jack Zhang worked as a dishwasher, bartender and cashier at a petrol station before he started Airwallex. Today, his fintech startup is worth $8 billion.
